title: Camelot Promotion
description: v1.2 promotion record for standby promotion (VPS → local twin). Requires fencing, integrity checks, authority-epoch change, and operator/witness approval per §6.4–§6.5. witness_lock_ref is required for auto_failover and T4 promote effects (§6.5, catalog comment). See Camelot-OS SADD+LLDD v1.2 §6.4 + §6.5.

mode.description: auto_failover requires witness lock AND operator MFA; manual_failover requires operator MFA only (§6.5).

witness_lock_ref.description: Reference to the witness-signed promotion lock grant. Required for auto_failover (§6.5); may be absent for manual_failover.

operator_approval_refs.description: Operator MFA approvals (two distinct identities required for T3+).

chain_integrity_verified.description: Local receipt-chain integrity verified per §11.3 (§6.4 step 1).

vps_unreachable_probe.description: Independent VPS health probe result (§6.4 step 3).

attested_quorum_count.description: Attested nodes that acknowledged the epoch broadcast (§7.3 quorum).
